title: WHO: Diabetes
text: Diabetes is a chronic disease that affects how the body regulates blood glucose. Information about symptoms, prevention and care should be discussed with a qualified health professional.

title: CDC: About Diabetes
text: Diabetes affects how the body turns food into energy. Different types of diabetes exist; professional testing is needed to determine whether a person has diabetes.

title: CDC: Preventing Type 2 Diabetes
text: Healthy eating and regular physical activity are among the steps discussed in prevention of type 2 diabetes. Individual plans should be discussed with healthcare professionals.
